name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2026-06-18, at wavelengths from 1.63 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
